items.title: 68089_John Malachi oral history interview
items.q: But he was around during the Jimmy Blanton fame, and the fame of a lot of other bass players

ctx.x: But when we got into Chicago, Sarah made arrangements to have a trio. She knew a couple of fellows in Chicago, a bass player who I had heard about since the late Thirties, who was a legend among bass players. The first I heard about him was when he was working with Fletcher Henderson, and from what I understand, he was a teenager at that particular. But this fellow's name was Israel Crosby. Which I have worked with a lot of bass players... I have worked with a lot of bass players before and since, and I have…

Too much can't be said about Israel Crosby as a musician and a bass player. The only thing about it is, he was a quiet, unassuming person that... All of the musicians knew what a great bass player he was. And bass players, off course, certainly knew. But he was around during the Jimmy Blanton fame, and the fame of a lot of other bass players,
